title: King Rose Dance Collective
role: Logo, corporate identity, social media posts, merch, open calls
lead: Black joy, elegance and strength. Identity, social media and merch for a Berlin dance collective.

blocks.title: Origin
blocks.text: The King Rose Dance Collective brings dancers together around Black joy, elegance and strength. As the collective grew, it needed an identity that could carry performances, open calls, social media and merch with one voice.

blocks.caption: Brand kit · primary logo, palette, typography and applications

blocks.title: Concept & design decisions
blocks.text: Letters that move like dancing bodies: a fluid, distorted wordmark that bends and stretches but stays legible. Black, electric blue, orange and a warm cream give the collective a bold palette for posts, open calls, booklets, hoodies and tote bags.
